measurement_basis: Before-and-after live Environmental Capability projection readbacks, bounded resource-sample status fields, and incremental plus capability-intelligence regressions.

related_work.work_intent_goal: Improve MNCS's ability to observe, interpret, and improve how the environment serves agents working within MNCS.

observation.source_interface: MNCS Environment environmental-capability projection and session resource-sample activity view

request.operation: preserve explicit resource-sample absence status in a size-compacted Environmental Capability response when it fits the response budget

outcome.implemented_behavior: The compact ECI view retains a minimal resource-sample status and measured counts for an empty, non-truncated artifact window only when the compact result still fits its response budget. Existing compact evidence priorities remain in effect when the summary will not fit.
outcome.effectiveness_assessment: The before-and-after compact projection behavior and regression coverage are verified. A status of not-captured-in-session establishes absence of a recorded sample in the selected artifact window; it does not establish zero resource use or agent burden.

pressure_hypothesis.title: A size-compacted capability projection omitted the explicit status when the selected session had no resource sample
pressure_hypothesis.subsystem: MNCS Environment capability-intelligence compact projection and Monitor sample relation
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Preserve the bounded no-sample status and measured zero sample count when an empty artifact window is complete and the compact response budget has room.

not_measured: Agent-attributed resource consumption or the amount of resource use when no Monitor sample is recorded.
Resource use represented by invocations outside the Environment session artifact window.
Whether agents make better decisions after seeing explicit no-sample status.
Whether the compact status reduces intervention burden or improves service outcomes.
